review_kind: Complete security and code-quality install-pointer cluster (Security & Verification, Code Quality & Review; 408 exact pinned packages), individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: Every install-pointer card in Security & Verification (222) and Code Quality & Review (186) was read in full and individually graded; all single-file auto-extracted README pointers. 2,569 of 3,196 AgentSkillExchange cards carry a publisher "security_reviewed" label; nothing in these packages evidences such a review.

112 cards claim capabilities the extracted content does not support: 13 SonarQube cards whose install lines are SonarQube server contributor build steps, 12 OWASP ZAP cards whose extract is CI badges, 14 Semgrep cards (7 with empty Installation), ESLint/Codecov/CodeClimate/Vault/npm wrappers, RFC 8446 "TLS validators" over the RFC text, and SBOM cards whose extract is Docker docs navigation.

42 cards advertise consequential actions without an authorization gate: automated fix PRs and auto-patching (Snyk, npm audit), PR comments/Checks API writes, secret rotation (Vault), live verification of discovered credentials (TruffleHog), registry delete/copy (skopeo), and active scanning/fuzzing of targets without scope confirmation (14 ZAP/nuclei/Hadrian cards flagged at integration for consistency with the darkmoon-pentest-mcp adjudication).

Six remote-code installs (e.g. murphysec `wget ... | /bin/bash`, bug-hunter `npx --yes` on an unpinned main tarball, reverse-skill following an upstream README_AI.md) and two cards instructing the agent to follow remote prompts were flagged.
22 misattributions, e.g. npm/Auth0/GraphQL Foundation/Cloudflare named as authors of synthetic wrappers, and an Anthropic-named install card owned by an individual.

Real security/quality tools (cloudsplaining, lynis, apko, djlint, htmltest, prompt-hardener, DOMPurify, Greywall, publint) score 9-10 as discovery leads but remain REJECT unchanged; the only REFERENCE-ONLY is recover-playwright-selectors-after-ui-refactors-with-qa-skills (commit-pinned install pointer with prerequisite gates that preserves existing skill directories).
